mapper.select: SELECT r.REG_ID, r.PACKAGE_ID, r.REG_TITLE, r.REG_PRICE, r.START_DT, r.END_DT, r.HIGHLIGHT, r.DESCRIPTION_A, r.DESCRIPTION_B, c.CTRY_NAME, l.LOC_NAME, i.IMG_PATH, i.ORIGIN_NAME FROM WISHLIST w JOIN REGISTER_PROD r ON w.REG_ID = r.REG_ID JOIN PACKAGES p ON r.PACKAGE_ID = p.PACKAGE_ID JOIN LOCATION l ON l.LOC_ID = p.LOC_ID JOIN COUNTRY c ON p.CTRY_ID = c.CTRY_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_MAPPING m ON m.REG_ID = r.REG_ID AND m.VIEW_SEQUENCE = ( SELECT MIN(m2.VIEW_SEQUENCE) FROM IMG_MAPPING m2 WHERE m2.REG_ID = r.REG_ID ) LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE i ON i.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO WHERE w.USER_ID = #{value} ORDER BY w.WISH_DT DESC, r.REG_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT c.REG_ID AS REG_ID, COUNT(*) OVER() AS CNT, r.REG_TITLE AS TITLE, NVL(i.IMG_PATH, '/assets/images/location/reg_default.jpg') AS IMG_PATH, TO_CHAR(r.START_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS START_YMD, TO_CHAR(r.END_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS END_YMD, r.REG_PRICE AS PRICE FROM CART c JOIN REGISTER_PROD r ON r.REG_ID = c.REG_ID LEFT JOIN IMG_MAPPING m ON m.REG_ID = r.REG_ID AND m.VIEW_SEQUENCE = ( SELECT MIN(m2.VIEW_SEQUENCE) FROM IMG_MAPPING m2 WHERE m2.REG_ID = r.REG_ID ) LEFT JOIN IMG_STORAGE i ON i.IMG_NO = m.IMG_NO WHERE c.USER_ID = #{value} ORDER BY c.REG_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
